quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：比较 JIT 与解释器的输出，标准答案取自 testinput1

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/pcre2/vulnerability_FZ_3/testinput1; adapted: testdata/testinput1, one of the RunTest inputs the exploit's `make check` runs with and without -jit (RunTest's failing input is not recorded), unchanged. Checked locally (as for FZ_1): testinput1, 2, 4, 5 and 10 differ on the injected build only; testinput1 differs on thousands of lines (the JIT's wrong captures vary from run to run, but always differ from the interpreter); the empty PoV is SAME.)

category5.design: The change only affects JIT matching, and the harnesses compare JIT and interpreter only with --enable-diff-fuzz-support, which this build lacks; a fixed judge script compares pcre2test -jit with the interpreter on the same build and the rule is a match on its DIFF verdict (a self-comparison, so build-specific output such as JIT code sizes cannot make the fixed build pass).

argv: p=/src/pcre2/pcre2test; "$p" -q -jit "$0" >jit.out 2>&1; echo "exit status $?" >>jit.out; "$p" -q "$0" >interpreter.out 2>&1; echo "exit status $?" >>interpreter.out; if cmp -s interpreter.out jit.out; then echo SAME; else echo DIFF; diff interpreter.out jit.out | head -n 40; fi
